What is the input to the *dynamical rule*? 

`r devoirs::devoirs_text("RQ11-lhh")`

<!-- Opening answer: R1d-6Yd -->
::: {.callout-tip collapse=true `r devoirs:::answer_style()`}
## Answer
The input to the dynamical rule is the *state* of the system, that is, the set of quantities that the state comprises.
